slides.layer2_text: Why do we go blank? Just like a pro golfer missing a 1-foot putt, pressure causes a panic response.
slides.layer4_explanation: The SAM axis initiates the fight-or-flight response, reducing working memory. You don't lose intelligence; you lose access to it.
slides.layer5_excerpt: Source: Tom Hendrick Public Speaking Library (Skill inhibition).

slides.layer2_text: We need a routine to calm our brain and our audience.
slides.layer4_explanation: Self-regulation lowers cognitive load to stop panic. Co-regulation calms the audience by proving you won't ramble.
